meta.title: EasyTV · Open-source AI short drama studio
meta.description: EasyTV is an open-source, self-hosted AI short drama platform: node canvas, one-prompt film, 3D director stage, server-side compositing, with built-in credits billing, model pricing and an admin console. The New API of short drama.

hero.subtitle: Plug any video, image or voice model into one canvas and go from script to final cut in one place. Credits billing, model pricing, payments and an admin console are built in. Deploy on your own servers.

showcase.title: One canvas, the whole short drama pipeline

features.title: A complete studio, benchmarked against commercial platforms
features.subtitle: Features were mapped one by one against LibTV and similar platforms. Canvas interaction, the director stage and smart editing have shipped; the gaps are on the roadmap.

items.title: Infinite canvas · node workflow
items.desc: Text, image, video, audio and storyboard-group nodes wired together. Cross-canvas copy/paste, grid split, prompt chaining along edges.

items.title: One-prompt film
items.desc: Conversational workflow generation: plan, characters, scenes, shots and voice-over from a single sentence, then refine shot by shot.

items.title: Series bible & plan
items.desc: Character bios, world, episode index and revisions. Each canvas records which draft it was built from and flags affected shots after edits.

items.title: 3D director stage
items.desc: Block characters, set cameras and camera moves in the browser, then export shot descriptions straight into video models.

items.title: Subject & style libraries
items.desc: Three-view character sheets and snapshot locks keep continuity. Official styles plus custom styles reverse-engineered from any image, shared after review.

items.title: Shot candidates & timeline compose
items.desc: Multiple candidates per shot, in/out points and volume per clip, original audio mixed with voice-over, SRT subtitles, server-side ffmpeg render.

items.title: Media tools
items.desc: Trim, split, extract frames, separate audio, remove silence, transcribe to subtitles. ffmpeg.wasm in the browser and ffmpeg on the server.

items.title: Remix hits
items.desc: Works can expose their process. Clone the canvas in one click to remix, with rewards flowing back to the author.

items.title: Skill library & agent
items.desc: Reusable workflow templates and a conversational canvas assistant that understands the current canvas.

items.title: Team spaces
items.desc: Switch between personal and team spaces, with roles, approval gates, shared credit pools and monthly member caps.

items.title: Credits · plans · model pricing
items.desc: Price per model per unit, member and launch promo prices, pre-deduction with refunds, hot-reloaded from the admin console.

items.title: Payments · invoices · affiliates
items.desc: WeChat Pay / Alipay, invoice requests, referral rewards and partner withdrawals, ready out of the box.

items.title: Admin console
items.desc: Users, works, community review, orders, model health, gateway balance checks and audit logs across twenty-plus pages.

items.title: Seven locales
items.desc: Simplified and Traditional Chinese, English, French, Japanese, Russian and Vietnamese built in, guarded by structured keys and coverage tests.

why.eyebrow: Why "the New API of short drama"
why.title: New API unified LLMs. EasyTV unifies short drama production.
why.p1: New API gathers every LLM behind one gateway: one interface, one billing model, one admin console. EasyTV does the same thing one layer up: it gathers video, image and voice models into one creation and operations platform, and talks to any New API / One API gateway through OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
why.p2: You don't negotiate with every model vendor, and you don't write billing or an admin console. Connect a gateway, import the model list, set prices, and a paid short drama studio is running.

cards.title: Any OpenAI-compatible gateway
cards.desc: /v1/chat, /v1/images and /v1/videos follow one contract. Pull the model list from the gateway and import it with pricing in one step.

cards.title: Credits are the tokens of short drama
cards.desc: Price per second, per image or per call. A margin factor suggests credits automatically; pre-deduction and refunds on failure are automatic.

cards.title: Gateway-grade admin
cards.desc: Model health, failure-rate alerts, suggested delisting and gateway balance checks, so operators never read logs.

cards.title: Works · skills · partners
cards.desc: Open works to remix, skill templates and partner affiliates let the platform grow its own content.

arch.title: Three repositories, one API contract
arch.subtitle: Separated front and back ends, token auth, and a contract in API.md that changes before the code does.

repos.name: easytv-web
repos.desc: The studio: canvas, one-prompt film, director stage, community and pricing. Deploys to Cloudflare Workers.

repos.name: easytv-api
repos.desc: The backend: users, credits, payments, job queue, compositing and gateway adapters. AutoMigrate schema, sqlmock smoke tests.

repos.name: easytv-manage
repos.desc: The admin console: users, works, review, orders, model pricing and system settings.

compare.title: Self-hosted open source, not a rented SaaS
compare.subtitle: The commercial column is compiled from public material; refer to each vendor for specifics.

rows.a: Any OpenAI-compatible gateway, your vendors and prices
Credits, plans and promos are yours to set
WeChat Pay / Alipay direct, invoices, affiliates, withdrawals
Assets, canvases and films live in your own storage
Team spaces, roles and approval gates built in
Public API contract, fork and extend

quickstart.title: Running in five minutes
quickstart.subtitle: Bring a MySQL instance and a token for a New API-compatible gateway. Everything else has defaults.

steps.title: Backend
steps.desc: Copy the env example, set SQL_DSN and ROOT_PASSWORD. The first start migrates the schema and creates the admin.

steps.title: Studio
steps.desc: Point it at the backend. Default port 3005.

steps.title: Admin console
steps.desc: Sign in as root, enter the gateway URL and key under System · Gateway, fetch the model list and import pricing.

quickstart.note: Production deployment, systemd, Nginx and seed data are documented in each repository's README.
